aboutText: SES Electrical Solutions is a locally owned electrical business based in Altona, proudly serving Melbourne's western suburbs. Our certified electricians deliver reliable residential and commercial electrical services with transparent, upfront pricing. Whether you need emergency repairs at midnight or a full switchboard upgrade, our skilled team is available 24 hours a day. We are the trusted choice for homeowners and businesses across Altona, Newport, Williamstown and surrounding areas.
servicesText: From emergency callouts to complete rewiring projects, our Altona-based electricians handle all electrical work across Melbourne's west with professionalism and care.

services.title: 24-Hour Emergency Electrical Services
services.desc: Faults, outages and electrical hazards attended to urgently, any time of day or night across Altona and surrounding suburbs.
